title: Luxury Estate~Resort Backyard~Pool/Spa~Pickleball
description:
Breakthrough Acres is a luxurious oasis of 6,000+ sq/ft with a resort-style backyard, luxury furnishings, and breathtaking sunset views. Located minutes from world-class golf courses, this stylish open concept home is perfect for golfers, families, or groups of friends looking for a luxury holiday with the beautiful Arizona nature at your doorstep.

8 Min Drive to Troon North Golf Club
13 Min Drive to Pinnacle Peak Park
17 Min Drive to TPC Scottsdale

★ Explore Scottsdale & Learn More Below ★

 The space 
KEY FEATURES:
☀ Resort-style backyard w/ stunning mountain views
☀ 5 bedrooms, each with their own full en-suite bathroom (11 beds altogether!)
☀ An additional bunk room with 2 twin over twin bunks
☀ 5 full bathrooms + 2 half baths
☀ Casita with rooftop viewing deck + seating + fire pit
☀ Pickleball Court
☀ Large outdoor pool + spa + waterslide + waterfall
☀ Indoor Games - ARCADES + pool table + board games
☀ Outdoor Games - giant connect four + ping pong + cornhole + putt putt golf course!
☀ Huge Kids Play Set
☀ 3 outdoor TVs with cable
☀ Fully-furnished patio w/ fire pit + large dining table
☀ 2 Modern, fully-stocked kitchens (inside & out)
☀ Mountain, desert + sunset views
☀ Smart TVs in every room 
☀ Peloton for getting in your cardio
☀ Lots of parking spaces for cars, an RV, or even a boat
☀ Close to great trails for walking, biking + jogging

☆☆ BEDROOMS ☆☆

This relaxing and luxurious desert escape features eleven comfortable beds across five lovely bedrooms. Each is thoughtfully decorated and equipped with a Smart TV and a spacious closet or dresser for you to store and easily access your things.

You’ll find a comfy king-sized bed in the master bedroom, and two more king-sized and one queen-sized beds in each of the other 3 bedrooms. One additional room also has 2 sets of twin over twin bunk beds. In addition to the main house, there is a Casita with King bed and a twin over full bunk bed. 

The master suite has a large ensuite bathroom with a soaking tub. This spacious room features its own fireplace and private outdoor patio with seating and firepit that will feel nice after a long day of golfing or exploring the nearby trails. Each of the other bedrooms features unique and fun decor, a Smart TV, room-darkening shades, and extra pillows and blankets to ensure a quality sleep during your stay.

☆☆ BATHROOMS ☆☆

The home features 5 full modern bathrooms with showers (master also has a soaking tub) and an additional 2 half bathrooms. The bathrooms are bright and spacious with large mirrors and plenty of counter space to make it easy for you to get ready for your day. They’re stocked with plush towels and the essential toiletries you’ll need for your stay.

☆☆ KITCHEN & LOUNGE ☆☆

The wide-open floor plan of this bright and airy home mirrors the wide-open spaces of the desert surrounding you. This spacious layout is perfect for large groups of golfers, a weekend getaway for a group of ladies or guys, or multiple families. 

The fully-equipped kitchen is complete with luxury finishes, a large island, and updated appliances, including a double oven, large fridge, and gas stove. Get your morning caffeine fix at the fully stocked coffee and tea bar to start your day off right.

The cabinets and drawers are stocked with the cookware and utensils you need to whip up delicious meals during your stay- you’ll even have a fully stocked spice drawer and a cocktail-making set! You can enjoy a meal at the counter stools or sit around one of 3 large dining tables, inside and out, with modern dining table sets for 16+ that overlook the swimming pool in the backyard.

When you feel like unwinding with friends or family indoors, enjoy the main living room with lounge areas and an extra-wide screen Smart TV, beautiful views, and luxurious finishes. Sink into a comfortable sofa and enjoy a glass of wine while the fireplace adds a relaxing ambiance. Keep yourself busy by shooting a game of pool or enjoying the many games provided, including arcade machines and board games!

☆☆ OUTSIDE SPACE ☆☆

Nothing beats lounging on the spacious fully-furnished patio while enjoying your private view of the resort-style back yard and Arizona landscape. Curl up on the comfy lounge furniture in the shade of an umbrella, or take a refreshing dip in your own private swimming pool with a waterfall and waterslide. And don’t forget 3 outdoor TVs with cable, a ping pong table, giant connect four, corn hole, putt putt golf, kids play set, Pickleball Court and huge lounge hangout area!

A full outdoor kitchen w/ grill and large dining table make it easy to BBQ something tasty for the group while enjoying the natural views. A massive fire pit and luxurious seating area make the outdoor area the perfect place to hang out well into the night. Enjoy the sounds of nature and watch the sun sink into the horizon as you lounge poolside. Did we mention the Casita has a viewing deck up top with yet another lounge area and fire pit?!

This beautiful resort-style home is located nearby several world-class golf courses, restaurants, shops, and amazing trails, so you’ll never get bored!

★☆ Book Today & Let Us Take Care Of You In Scottsdale! ☆★

 Guest access 
As a guest, you will have access to all the amenities, including the swimming pool, spa, laundry facilities, pool table, and more. There is plenty of parking space for multiple vehicles, including an RV and a boat. 

If you’re traveling with little ones, you’ll find everything to keep them happy, including a Pack ’n Play, a high chair, children’s dinnerware, fireplace guards, and board games!

This comfortable house is single-level, meaning you won’t have to climb any stairs.

To provide keyless and contactless check-in, there’s a smart lock on-site, so your group can enter easily without fumbling with keys.

 Other things to note 
WE REQUIRE 3 THINGS WITHIN 24 HOURS OF BOOKING. NO EXCEPTIONS
(Links to all 3 items below will be provided in your reservation confirmation message)

1. Complete the Guest ID Verification (just like any hotel)
We are committed to protecting our properties which is why we've partnered with Truvi, the leading vacation rental guest-screening provider. PLEASE NOTE that before your booking is fully confirmed, you will need to verify your details through Know Your Guest.

Don’t worry, our process is short and simple. Please have your government-issued ID (passport, driving license, ID card etc.) nearby. You will need to submit a copy just like you would at a hotel.
You will also be given the choice between paying a refundable deposit or buying a small $35 non-refundable damage waiver. We suggest you buy the damage waiver as this protects you in case you cause accidental damage during a booking.

2. Digitally sign our rental agreement 

3. Complete Guest Arrival Form

PET POLICIES (Only Dogs Allowed)

Dog Amenities, Fees, and Policies:
- $150 Pet Fee
- 2 Dogs Maximum (must receive pre-approval from host)
- No Puppies
- Must be fully potty trained
- Back yard is fenced (be sure to always check that all gates are closed)
- Must be on leash at all times when outside of fenced in back yard
- Must pick up all dog waste, tie it up in doggie bag, and dispose of it in large trash cans outside garage (no waste in indoor trash cans)
- No dogs allowed in the pool or spa
- Guest must control dog barking when outside to respect neighbors
- Dogs are to follow quiet hours, just like humans, from 9:30pm to 8:00am
- Any unattended pets must be left in a crate when guests are not in direct supervision. Any damage to the homes doors, walls, flooring, furniture, or linens, etc due to lack of supervision or crating the pet, will result in additional charges for repair.
- Guest must report any damage to host immediately 
- Dog Amenities Provided: 2 food bowls, 2 water bowls, 2 leashes, poop bags, 1 large crate, dog pee pads, 1 medium size dog bed

VERY IMPORTANT:
PLEASE LET US KNOW IN ADVANCE IF YOU WANT POOL/SPA HEATED FOR YOUR STAY BECAUSE WE HAVE TO START HEATING IT 1-2 DAYS BEFORE YOUR ARRIVAL FOR THE WATER TO BE HEATED IN TIME FOR YOUR CHECK-IN. 
Pool/Spa heating is $125/day, with a 3-day minimum.
